name: read-record-with-purged-blueprint-answers-blueprint-unresolvable
description: A durable record survives its render and names a blueprint, but the blueprint is gone. The read answers BLUEPRINT_UNRESOLVABLE on -32006 — not an internal error. Nothing malfunctioned: the record kept its promise and the thing it pointed at was reaped. A host reading -32006 knows a retry of this locator cannot succeed, which -32603 would have told it the opposite of.
